value.rationale: The object is a standard sharp constrained least-squares approximation; two-input BV sensitivity measures behavior not controlled by Hilbert nonexpansivity. The complete exact finite-tree mass-dependent modulus is an invariant over all edge bands, with sharp local witnesses, a genuinely nonlocal six-vertex gain and degree-three caterpillars with unbounded gain.
